claim_boundary: This campaign can certify only the exact BR9.0 digest-bound existing-contact brace-controller arithmetic, mirrored arrest, bounded load-rate redistribution, explicit residual, and stable-dwell handoff scope; BR9.1 reserve, friction, existing-contact-set, detector-state, finiteness, strict-field, monotonic-tick, and delayed-reaction refusal scope; BR9.2 controller-to-force-map-to-finite-paired-actuator-to-command-ledger-to-executor-to-append-only-receipt scope; and BR9.3 paired no-brace-control and active-brace Godot/Jolt program scope named by the source-pinned programs. BR9.4 is integrity-only containment and cannot substitute for a milestone program. The live pair retains the exact BR7 material scaffold: an explicit unpowered Generic6DOF guide releases sagittal X/Y translation and pitch while locking out-of-plane translation, roll, and yaw; all guide motors and springs remain off; four hinges remain passive; and two ordinary distal contacts are already bearing before the one declared positive pitch impulse. The active controller begins only on the first post-impulse observation, redistributes commanded contact loads inside the declared unilateral, friction, reserve, load-rate, and finite-actuator boundaries, and is compared with a no-brace control receiving the same impulse. Whole-system angular-momentum reconstruction supplies the aggregate external pitch-moment check. Commanded left/right shares are not measured per-foot loads. This establishes scaffold-constrained planar existing-contact pitch arrest only, not a new-contact catch step, per-foot measured load allocation, free-3D bracing or standing, articulated-limb generality, fall arrest, getting up, gait, walking, creature repair, accepted knowledge, or automatic creature guidance.

programs.claim_scope: The strict controller seals one immutable configuration, mirrors signed momentum-arrest requests, preserves reserve-aware unilateral feasibility, rate-limits contact-load redistribution, exposes exact desired and achieved residuals, retains command-not-measurement semantics, and enters STABILIZE only after the complete declared safe dwell.

The controller fails closed for insufficient reserved normal capacity, reserved friction-cone overflow, an absent pre-existing contact, REACTION_TOO_LATE, a non-BRACE observation, nonfinite momentum, caller-added root rescue, nonmonotonic ticks, and a configuration that reserves away its physical envelope.

One bounded brace command maps through the certified vertical contact-force seam into paired finite joint-torque plans, seals through the command ledger, executes only equal-and-opposite joint torques, reconciles append-only receipts, retains no-root/no-pin/no-new-contact boundaries, and rejects a forged direct root-force operation.

Fresh no-brace-control and active-brace Godot/Jolt worlds retain the exact unpowered planar scaffold, passive hinges, ordinary already-bearing distal contacts, finite paired actuators, command receipts, and one identical positive pitch impulse. The active controller begins only on the first post-impulse observation and reduces aggregate angular-momentum area and pitch excursion while both original contacts remain bearing and every declared rate, residual, actuator, handoff, and intervention boundary passes.

Integrity-only containment proves that digest mutation, missing timing authority, hidden motors or root rescue, foot pinning, new support contact, false per-foot measurement, automatic guidance, free-3D or catch-step claims, late actuation, insufficient paired improvement, contact loss, and actuator-identity substitution fail closed.

does_not_establish: Per-contact, per-foot, or per-toe measured load allocation
Free 3D bracing, standing, or unconstrained balance
An absent, negligible, or measured out-of-plane scaffold reaction
Articulated-limb, morphology, terrain, complex-foot, or endurance generalization
Creature repair, accepted encyclopedia knowledge, or automatic creature guidance
